info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Risk Model Retrieval API allows users to access specific operational risk models using a unique identifier. This endpoint empowers financial institutions and risk management professionals to efficiently retrieve detailed information about models associated with operational risk, facilitating compliance and assessment activities. Typical consumers include risk managers, compliance officers, and data analysts looking to analyze or validate operational risk frameworks. This API enhances decision-making by providing quick access to essential risk model data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific operational risk model identified by its unique identifier. You can use this data to assess and understand the risk parameters and methodologies applied within the model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operational risk model details based on a specific model identifier. The input should include relevant parameters to filter and specify the exact model required.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the operational risk model details.

GetModelByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the operational risk models. It is expected to be a string value.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.title: Operational Risk Model Response

modelId.description: Unique identifier for the operational risk model.

modelVersion.description: Version of the operational risk model.

portfolioId.description: Identifier for the portfolio associated with the model.

asOfDate.description: Date as of which the model is applicable.

scenario.description: Scenario under which the model is evaluated.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level associated with the model outputs.

validationDatasetId.description: Identifier for the dataset used for validating the model.

backtestWindowMonths.description: Length of the backtesting window in months.

approvalStatus.description: Current approval status of the operational risk model.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record in the system.

version.description: Version number of the response schema.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.

correlationId.description: Identifier to track the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region in which the processing took place.

metadata.description: Metadata information related to the operational risk model response.

GetModelByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response structure of an operational risk model.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the API endpoint being accessed.

X-Runtime-App.description: Name of the runtime application that processed the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses bearer authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header as a Bearer token to access secured endpoints.
